description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s with a neat, short haircut. He is wearing a crisp, formal Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform including a blue shirt with official badges, dark trousers, and polished black shoes. He has a stern yet authoritative presence.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his mid-20s representing a young professional. He has short black hair and is wearing a white button-down office shirt tucked into charcoal grey trousers with a black leather belt and brown dress shoes.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless humanoid silhouette composed of digital static and glowing blue binary code. The figure has no facial features and wears a dark hooded cloak that obscures any human identity, representing a digital threat.
